action_items.detail: Phase 1 browser check 'lending-readonly-mobile-individual' checks for disabled 'Coming in Phase 2' lending actions. Phase 2 replaced that behaviour, so the check was not rerun. Phase 2 lending at 390px is covered by 'lending-request-accept-repay-mobile'.

e1_tests/test_tscheck_lending.py was updated: the disclaimer match is now case-insensitive, because the Phase 2 copy is 'Obligation tracking only. No provider credits are transferred.' This was a test change, not an app bug.

The 300-credit partial-approval test raises Arjun's seeded allocation. The test then sets it back to its earlier value (5000) through PUT /allocation/members. The manager reallocation test moves 10 credits and then moves them back. Seed state was checked afterwards: Engineering unallocated is still 1000, the org budget is 50,000 and Kwame has 83 available.

tests/race_probe.py needs the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL environment variable. It was run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 and printed ALL OK. All pytest runs used -n 0 so they ran one after another, as the briefing asked.

Residue left in the tscheck namespace: tscheck-*@example.com individual users with their friendships and loans, a friendship between a tscheck user and Kwame, and rejected or cancelled resource requests whose reason starts with 'tscheck-'. No seeded rows were modified apart from the allocation changes above, which were restored. Real Google sign-in still needs a human to test.

checks.criterion: Friends + lending creation/validation; accept/decline + balances; repayments + overdue; lending access (JRN-19..34)
checks.name: test_tscheck_p2_lending.py
checks.evidence: 5 tests passed. POST /friends/requests with an unknown or org email returns 4xx 'No individual user found with that email'. Lending amounts of 0, -5 and 2.5 return 400/422 with fields.amount. Cancel gives cancelled. Decline gives declined and available is unchanged. Two parallel accepts return [200,409]; available moves +100/-100 once. Repaying 500 returns 400 'Repayment exceeds outstanding amount'. A 40 repayment confirmed leaves outstanding 60 and adds a history repayment_confirmed. A dispute marks the repayment disputed and outstanding stays 60. Repaying the full amount gives status repaid with outstanding 0. Kwame accepting a 500 request returns 'Not enough available credits to lend'. lnd_001 has overdue=true. A third party and the org admin get 403 on GET /lending/entries/{id}.

checks.criterion: Lending flow at 390px incl. disclaimer on page/dialog/entry panel, unknown email, inline amount error (JRN-19,22,24,28,29,35)
checks.name: lending-request-accept-repay-mobile
checks.evidence: At 390px: the 5 summary cards, the tabs and the page disclaimer are shown. An unknown email shows 'No individual user found with that email'. Amount 0 shows field-error-amount. A request for 40 is created; after the friend accepts, the entry shows active and Borrowed shows 40. The entry sheet shows its disclaimer. Over-repaying shows 'Repayment exceeds outstanding amount'. A repayment of 15 is recorded. scrollWidth overflow is at most 1px.

checks.criterion: Budgets + allocations; employee requests + approvals; records; reconcile (JRN-36..50)
checks.name: test_tscheck_p2_allocation.py
checks.evidence: 4 tests passed. Over-budget changes return the exact errors 'Department budgets exceed organisation budget' and 'Allocations exceed department budget'. Manager reallocation of 10 within Engineering returns 200 and persists. Sofia moving credits to Aisha (Marketing) returns 403. Moving more than the source's unused returns 400 with 'unused allocation'. A 500 high request is visible to Sofia and Daniel. Amount 0 with a blank reason returns 422 with the amount and reason fields. A 300 partial approval adds 300 to Arjun and takes 300 from the pool. Approving 50,000 returns 'Not enough unallocated department budget'. A rejection note is visible to Arjun. Cancel gives cancelled. Employee approve and PUT member both return 403. audit_log and notifications records exist. scripts/reconcile.py exits 0 (ALL OK).

checks.criterion: Admin budgets, members table, Underutilised panel, over-budget UI errors (JRN-36,37)
checks.name: allocation-admin-budgets-errors
checks.evidence: The admin page shows an org budget of 50,000, 4 department rows, member health pills and the underutilised panel. Setting the Engineering budget to 1 shows 'Allocations exceed department budget'. Setting the org budget to 1 shows 'Department budgets exceed organisation budget'. Values are unchanged afterwards.

checks.criterion: Employee request UI, inline validation, rejection note shown to Arjun (JRN-41,42,43,46)
checks.name: allocation-employee-request-reject-note
checks.evidence: Arjun sees only his own panel and no departments table. Amount 0 shows an inline field error. A 500 high request is submitted and Sofia's API lists it as high. After Sofia rejects it, Arjun sees status 'rejected' and the note.
